notes: Stock / sales / purchasing grants of a group (ST_STORE_PASSWORD, ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD, ST_GROUP_PASSWORD; read by APP_RULES_ST / SA / PR / APP_CONV); show-cost flag, all stores / types / item groups and select all / none buttons (APP_RULES3_SE, see processes/SEPASS_TRN.md)

ST_GROUP_PASSWORD.GROUP_CODE.lov: select item_group_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, item_group_code r from st_item_group where nvl(group_status, 0) = 1 order by item_group_code

actions.name: ALL_ROWS
actions.confirm_a: سيتم استبدال صلاحيات المجموعة من هذا النوع بكل السجلات. هل تريد الاستمرار؟

params.name: KIND
params.lov_sql: select case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then e else a end d, r from (select 'كل المخازن' a, 'All stores' e, 'STORE' r, 1 s from dual union all select 'كل الحركات', 'All transaction types', 'TRNS', 2 from dual union all select 'كل المجموعات', 'All item groups', 'GROUP', 3 from dual) order by s

params.name: TBL
params.lov_sql: select case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then e else a end d, r from (select 'المخازن' a, 'Stores' e, 'ST_STORE_PASSWORD' r, 1 s from dual union all select 'الحركات', 'Transaction types', 'ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD', 2 from dual union all select 'المجموعات', 'Item groups', 'ST_GROUP_PASSWORD', 3 from dual) order by s

params.name: FLAG
params.lov_sql: select case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then e else a end d, r from (select 'إختيار الكل' a, 'Select all' e, 1 r from dual union all select 'استبعاد الكل', 'Deselect all', 0 from dual) order by r desc
